# Smoke-test list. Public, non-personal addresses chosen so that between them
# they exercise most branches of the decision tree. Kept short on purpose:
# every line costs one charged event when scripts/smoke-test.mjs runs.
#
# Four of these already have recorded output in expected/ — measured, not
# assumed. The rest are filled in the first time the smoke test runs.
#
# Never add the owner's company domain here: bulk SMTP probing a domain you
# actually send business mail from is how an IP or a domain gets flagged.

# --- syntax (never leaves the process, costs nothing to be generous with) ---
plainaddress
user@
two..dots@example.com

# --- domain does not resolve ---
someone@never-exists-xyz-9f2k.com

# --- disposable ---
test@mailinator.com

# --- free provider: reachable, but no mailbox verdict is possible ---
someone@gmail.com

# --- catch-all domain: accepts everything, so nothing can be confirmed ---
zz-catchall-a1@stripe.com

# --- role address that exists ---
admin@angelnumbercodex.com

# --- the money path: a real mailbox, and one that is definitely absent ---
sumit@angelnumbercodex.com
no.such.person.99312@angelnumbercodex.com
